text:
Palladium Price in 2015
Among 12 monthly observations available for 2015, the LBMA palladium price fell 28.4% between 2015-01-30 ($775) and 2015-12-30 ($555). The highest sampled price was $808 in February and the lowest was $538 in November. The mean of these observations was $680. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
What happened in 2015:
A strong US dollar and expectations of Federal Reserve rate hikes pushed gold to multi-year lows.
